provenance.purpose: reduce reconstruction compute while preserving an action-rich forecast interval

window_selection.rule: maximize mean gripper-centre path weighted at each step by the minimum endpoint closure confidence
window_selection.controller_centre: arithmetic mean of the five released action points per gripper
window_selection.closure_confidence: per gripper, clip((episode aperture p90 - aperture)/(episode aperture p90 - episode aperture p10), 0, 1); smaller released aperture means more closed
window_selection.static_aperture_fallback: confidence one, reducing exactly to unweighted path when aperture cannot identify closure
window_selection.step_weight: minimum closure confidence at the two endpoints of each gripper-centre path step
window_selection.gripper_aggregation: mean of per-gripper closure-weighted path lengths; gripper vectors are never averaged before taking their norms

candidate_starts.stop: last start whose complete 81-frame window exists

claim_boundary.description: This addendum changes temporal staging cost, not the model, object split, held-information boundary, or published comparison claim.
